name: Northern Michigan Equine Therapy

profile.name: Northern Michigan Equine Therapy
profile.description: Northern Michigan Equine Therapy is a 501(c)(3) non-profit outpatient rehabilitation facility dedicated to equine assisted therapy using the healing nature of a horse as a therapeutic tool to enhance independence, self-confidence, and quality of life of our clients. With the natural movement and demeanor of a horse we help those with physical, emotional, and/or mental health needs. NMET is a support system to the community. With a horse’s guidance and support, our Occupational Therapy (Hippotherapy), HorseSense® Self Development, and At-Risk Youth programs are offered by licensed professionals and equine specialists to provide the community with the best quality of service to those in need. Our purpose is to assist and strengthen what is needed for a more fulfilling and independent life. The mission of NMET is to harness the healing powers of horses to improve lives.

视频标题提到“Hippotherapy”，与马辅助治疗（服务人）分支术语一致。
视频标题提到“Horses Healing Humans The NMET Story”，与频道简介中“harness the healing powers of horses to improve lives”的定位一致。
